item.name: Verify Payment Proof (Approve)
item._postman_note: Marks the invoice as paid (status=paid, paidAt/paidBy set) and paymentProof.status=verified. Fails with 400 if there is no pending_review proof on this invoice.

item.name: Reject Payment Proof
item._postman_note: Invoice stays unpaid; paymentProof.status=rejected with reviewNotes. Customer can resubmit via POST /customer/payments/invoices/:invoiceId/payment-proof, which resets it to pending_review.
Backs the Customer Panel "Upload Transaction Receipt" flow — customer uploads proof (stays pending), admin/sales verifies or rejects here. Uses {{token}} (admin/sales), not the customer token.

item.name: Deliveries Calendar
item._postman_note: Fixed a crash: deliveries whose Lead had been deleted produced the string "null" (String(null) is truthy, so .filter(Boolean) missed it) which then failed ObjectId casting downstream in fetchShipperVendorsByLeadIds, returning {"success":false,"message":"Invalid leadId: null"} for the whole calendar. Same bug existed in 2 other list endpoints in this file (all-deliveries, awarded loads) — fixed in all three.
